title: Face-selective ventral occipito-temporal responses to fast periodic visual stimulation, SEEG (Jonas et al., 2016) (derivative)
description: Stereo-EEG recordings from 28 patients with refractory epilepsy during fast periodic visual stimulation, in which natural object images were presented at 6 Hz with faces appearing as every fifth image (1.2 Hz), alongside a non-periodic control condition with faces at random positions. The data support mapping of face-selective responses across the human ventral occipito-temporal cortex. This derivative release contains the authors' low-pass filtered (30 Hz) Letswave sequences repackaged in BrainVision format, not the raw Micromed recordings.
methods_description: SEEG was recorded at 512 Hz with a 256-channel amplifier in intracerebral electrodes (0.8 mm diameter, 8-15 contacts each), together with some scalp EEG channels. The authors imported the original Micromed TRC files into Letswave 5, applied a 4th-order Butterworth 30 Hz low-pass filter, cropped each sequence to run from 2 s after onset to about 65 s, and merged sequences per condition. The files were then repackaged in BrainVision format with the values left unchanged.
